senses.gloss: (contr. of אל גב = עַל, cmp. אַ־) prop. on the back, on top of, hence, upon, on the basis; (logic.) by dint of, on account of; by the way of.
units: Snh. 95ᵇ א׳ אורחך while on thy road, i.e. incidentally, occasionally. Freq. אורחא א׳, v. אוֹרְחָא.—
B. Mets. 21ᵇ א׳ דיקירי because they are heavy.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 11b:6">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מטלטלין א׳ מקרקעי</he> the sale of movable chattel made binding by dint of immovable property jointly sold; cmp. <cite ref="S02174"><he>קַרְקַע</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 26b:9">Kidd. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ אחר</he> by means of somebody else (taking possession in behalf of the absent person).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 27a:6">Ib. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מי בעינן א׳</he> is it necessary that he must say, ‘Acquire movable by dint of acquiring landed property’?—

<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:9">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>כל א׳ גביא בעיא</he> every claim the legality of which rests on some additional circumstance (e.g. a loan collectible only on producing the note of indebtedness) requires collection (cannot be considered actual property until collected).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 116a:6">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ כתב הוא דקדוש</he> the parchment is sacred only on account of the sacred character of what is written on it.—
